post.description:
This API creates creatives of various types via multipart/form-data. The metadata is sent as a JSON string in the 'creativeRequest' form field, and files (when creativeSourceType is 'FILE') are uploaded in the 'creativeFiles' form field. Supports batch creation of multiple creatives in a single request, with partial success/failure handling.

The 'creativeRequest' JSON is a map where each key is a unique reference ID (e.g. 'I001') and each value is an object with these fields:

Common fields: creativeName (String, required), platformCreativeTypeId (Integer, required: 11=Image, 13=HTML, 14=Video, 15=Native, 17=Audio), creativeSourceType (String enum, required: FILE | URL | HTML | HTML5 | VAST_URL | VAST_XML | DAAST_URL | DAAST_XML), creativeSource (String, required), clickUrl (String, required for non-VAST/DAAST types), externalCreativeId (String, optional), subMediaType (String, required for Native: 'image' or 'video').

Type-specific nested objects:
- imageDetails: {creativeWidth, creativeHeight, pixelUrl} — for platformCreativeTypeId=11
- htmlDetails: {creativeWidth, creativeHeight} — for platformCreativeTypeId=13
- videoDetails: {creativeWidth, creativeHeight, duration, customTracking:{startUrl, firstQuartileURL, midPointURL, thirdQuartileURL, completeURL, impressionURL}} — for platformCreativeTypeId=14
- audioDetails: {duration, logoSource, logoHeight, logoWidth, customTracking:{...}} — for platformCreativeTypeId=17
- nativeDetails: {title, description, cta:{id, ctaText, defaultCta}, brandName, brandIconSourceUrl, brandIconHeight, brandIconWidth, thumbnailSourceUrl, thumbnailHeight, thumbnailWidth} — for platformCreativeTypeId=15, combined with imageDetails (subMediaType='image') or videoDetails (subMediaType='video').

**URL validation rules (for creativeSource, logoSource, brandIconSourceUrl, thumbnailSourceUrl):**
- Only `http` and `https` schemes are allowed. `file://`, `ftp://`, and other protocols are rejected.
- HTTP redirects are followed (max 5 hops) with each redirect destination validated against the same rules.
- File size must be greater than 0 bytes.
- File extension is determined from the URL path only; query parameters are not considered for extension validation.

patch.description:
This API endpoint allows authorized users to update the status of an existing creative. 
 Updating a creative's status to "deleted" is how to remove a creative from the system. 
 The creative's attributes can be modified by advertisers, workspaces, or super users. 
 Additionally, ownership and edit permissions are validated to ensure the request is authorized.

 Status IDs: 1 pending, 2 running, 3 paused, 4 deleted, 5 rejected. Allowed changes:

 - Delete (4): from running, pending, paused or rejected. Creatives used in a bid model cannot be deleted.
 - Restore to pending (1): from deleted.
 - Pause (3): from running.
 - Run (2): from paused, or from pending (approval).
 - Reject (5): from pending or running. creativeRejectionReason is required (400 without it).

 Approving (pending to running) and rejecting need approval access: an app-owner organization and a user  with approval permission (otherwise 403). Creatives in different statuses can be updated together only when  deleting or rejecting. Other invalid changes return 422.

Reject creative.summary: Set creativeStatusId to 5 and provide rejection reason

creativeRequest.description:
JSON string containing a map of unique identifiers to creative metadata objects. Each key is a temporary reference ID (any unique string, e.g. 'I001', 'H001', 'V001'). Each value is a CreateCreativeRequest object with these fields:

--- Common Fields (all creative types) ---
- creativeName (String, required): Name of the creative.
- platformCreativeTypeId (Integer, required): 11=Image, 13=HTML, 14=Video, 15=Native, 17=Audio.
- creativeSourceType (String enum, required): Must be one of: FILE, URL, HTML, HTML5, VAST_URL, VAST_XML, DAAST_URL, DAAST_XML. FILE means upload via creativeFiles; URL means external URL; HTML means raw HTML markup; VAST_URL/VAST_XML and DAAST_URL/DAAST_XML are for video/audio ad-serving tags.
- creativeSource (String, required): The content source. For FILE: must match a filename in creativeFiles. For URL: the full URL. For HTML: the HTML markup string. For VAST_XML/DAAST_XML: the XML string. For VAST_URL/DAAST_URL: the URL to the XML document.
- clickUrl (String, required for IMAGE/HTML/VIDEO/AUDIO/NATIVE with FILE or URL source): Click-through URL.
- externalCreativeId (String, optional): Third-party creative ID.
- subMediaType (String, optional): Required for Native creatives only. Must be 'image' or 'video'.

--- Type-Specific Detail Objects (nested inside each creative) ---

For Image creatives (platformCreativeTypeId=11), include 'imageDetails' object:
  - creativeWidth (Integer): Image width in pixels.
  - creativeHeight (Integer): Image height in pixels.
  - pixelUrl (String, optional): Tracking pixel URL.

For HTML creatives (platformCreativeTypeId=13), include 'htmlDetails' object:
  - creativeWidth (Integer, required): HTML creative width in pixels.
  - creativeHeight (Integer, required): HTML creative height in pixels.

For Video creatives (platformCreativeTypeId=14), include 'videoDetails' object (required when creativeSourceType is FILE or URL; not used for VAST_URL/VAST_XML):
  - creativeWidth (Integer): Video width in pixels.
  - creativeHeight (Integer): Video height in pixels.
  - duration (Long): Duration in seconds.
  - customTracking (Object, optional): {startUrl, firstQuartileURL, midPointURL, thirdQuartileURL, completeURL, impressionURL} — all Strings.

For Audio creatives (platformCreativeTypeId=17), include 'audioDetails' object (required when creativeSourceType is FILE or URL; not used for VAST_URL/VAST_XML/DAAST_URL/DAAST_XML):
  - duration (Long): Duration in seconds.
  - logoSource (String, optional): Logo image URL.
  - logoHeight (Integer, optional): Logo height in pixels.
  - logoWidth (Integer, optional): Logo width in pixels.
  - customTracking (Object, optional): {startUrl, firstQuartileURL, midPointURL, thirdQuartileURL, completeURL, impressionURL} — all Strings.

For Native creatives (platformCreativeTypeId=15), include 'nativeDetails' object AND the media detail object:
  nativeDetails:
  - title (String): Creative title.
  - description (String): Creative description.
  - cta (Object, optional): {id (Integer), ctaText (String), defaultCta (Boolean)}.
  - brandName (String): Brand name.
  - brandIconSourceUrl (String): Brand icon URL.
  - brandIconHeight (Integer): Brand icon height.
  - brandIconWidth (Integer): Brand icon width.
  - thumbnailSourceUrl (String, optional): Thumbnail URL (for native video).
  - thumbnailHeight (Integer, optional): Thumbnail height.
  - thumbnailWidth (Integer, optional): Thumbnail width.
  Also include 'imageDetails' (when subMediaType='image') or 'videoDetails' (when subMediaType='video') as described above.
  Native video creatives also support VAST_URL and VAST_XML as creativeSourceType.

--- Key Patterns (convention, not enforced) ---
H001-H999 (HTML), I001-I999 (Image), V001-V999 (Video), A001-A999 (Audio), NI001-NI999 (Native Image), NV001-NV999 (Native Video). Any unique string works as a key.

creativeFiles.description: Array of creative files to upload. This field is required when any creative in the creativeRequest has creativeSourceType set to 'FILE'. The filename of each uploaded file must match the creativeSource value specified in the corresponding creative metadata. Supported file types include images (JPEG, PNG, GIF), videos (MP4, WebM), and audio (MP3, WAV). Multiple files can be uploaded in a single request to support batch creative creation.
